name: plugin
summary: Build the JUCE 8 plugin (VST3/AU/Standalone, WebView editor embedding web/dist), run pluginval (strictness 5), and load the built VST3 headlessly like a DAW: golden fixtures must hash exactly like the native engine and the editor must build the stage from the patch. `package` makes the notarised universal macOS installer (BlokDust-<version>-Mac.pkg). `ios build|test` builds the iPadOS AUv3 inside the BlokDust app for the Simulator and loads it out of process like AUM: golden hashes ≡ native, state round-trip, editor bd_ready; and checks the app itself: output-only audio, no microphone entry, patch saved and restored (CHG-0025). `ios archive` makes the App Store build (the live site, distribution signing) and checks it: one version and build number, privacy manifests, encryption declared; it exports an .ipa, or with --upload sends it to App Store Connect.
usage: pnpm bd plugin ios archive [--build N] [--upload]
